question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A small structure with one or more open sides that is used to vend merchandise
solution:
The correct answer is "Kiosk."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• A **kiosk** is a small, standalone structure or booth typically located in public places, such as malls, airports, or outdoor areas. (सड़क पर बनी बहुत छोटी दुकान जहाँ अख़बार, मिठाइयाँ आदि बिकती है; गुमटी, स्‍टॉल)
 
• It is designed to provide information, services, or products to people in a self-service manner.
 
• The term** "kiosk"** can also refer to a small open-fronted hut or pavilion, especially one in a public space for the sale of newspapers, refreshments, or other goods.
 
• So, a small structure with one or more open sides that is used to vend merchandise is called **"Kiosk."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vendor: **a person who is selling something. (बेचने वाला व्‍यकि्त; विक्रेता)
 
• **Podium: **a small platform for a speaker, a performer, etc. to stand on. (छोटा मंच जिस पर वक्ता, कलाकार आदि खड़े होते हैं)
 
• **Stand: **a table or an object that holds or supports something, often so that people can buy it or look at it. (वस्‍तु को टेकने या टिकाने का साधन (कोई मेज़ आदि) (ताकि लोग उस वस्‍तु को देख सकें, ख़रीद सकें); स्‍टैंड)
